from.place: right adjoint commutes with direct sums: the derived direct image of a perfect object is perfect

title: Perfect direct image along a perfect proper morphism
statement: Let Y be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to Y be a perfect proper morphism of schemes (perfect means finite Tor dimension, equivalently that \mathcal O_X has finite Tor dimension over f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y), and let P be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then Rf_*P [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex].

proof.text: Properness supplies local finite type and quasi-compactness [def-weil-proper-morphism]. The proved library theorem isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType gives a Noetherian source. Apply [lem-pc-perfect-noetherian-cohomology] to P to obtain global cohomological bounds and coherence of every cohomology sheaf.

For each cohomology sheaf F, [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] gives quasi-coherence and finite type. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed] its nonzero-stalk locus is closed. Equip this locus with its reduced induced closed subscheme [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Its closed immersion is proper, and composition with f is proper. This gives HasSupportProperOver f F directly, with no choice of arbitrary subscheme.

Apply [lem-pc-perfect-relative-finite-tor] using compactness of X, local finite type of f, the Noetherian base, stalkwise finite Tor dimension and perfection of P. This gives HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f P.

Apply [lem-pc-bounded-coherent-finite-tor-proper-pushforward-perfect] to the bounds, coherence, proper supports and relative finite Tor dimension constructed above. It yields exactly that the derived direct image of P is perfect on Y.
